parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the refrigerator is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that supports all other components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity, houses insulation, and supports the doors, shelves, and cooling system.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left door of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel, includes a handle and possibly a dispenser area.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the refrigerator compartment and may include a water or ice dispenser.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right door of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel, typically covers the freezer or secondary compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the freezer or secondary storage area.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side control panel is made of durable plastic and is located on the refrigerator’s front or side edge.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to adjust temperature, modes, and other operational settings.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed but includes buttons or touch-sensitive areas for user interaction.
